N-terminal pyrophosphorylase domain produces UDP-GlcNAc from GlcNAc-1-phosphate and UTP; C-terminal acetyltransferase domain produces GlcNAc-1-phosphate from GlcN-1-phosphate and acetyl-CoA.
Reviewed homologs bind one Mg2+ per subunit and are cytoplasmic homotrimers.
